SIEM Query Playground

Privacy & scoring

You can practice without an account. Queries and scratch data run in your browser. Guest progress and drafts stay in local storage on this device.

When signed in with Google, checking an exercise sends that query, dataset, language, and exercise number to our server for verification. Submitted query text is processed but is not stored in account records. Google identity is verified on the server. We store your Google account identifier as a hash, your verified email and Google name, public display name, join date, and verified exercise completions in private storage. We do not receive your Google password.

Your public display name, points, scenario count, and completed language path count appear on the leaderboard. Your email and Google name are available only to the site administrator. Choose a display name that you are comfortable sharing.

Each correct exercise earns one point per dataset and language, once. All ten exercises in one language complete a scenario. Completing the same scenario in other languages adds points and language paths, but does not add another distinct scenario. Historical guest progress is not added to rankings. Visible solutions make this a practice tool, not a certification exam.

A first-party cookie identifies a browser for approximate unique visitor counts. It contains a random identifier and expires after one year. Its hash, first-visit date, and a broad source label from tagged links (such as LinkedIn or community) are stored. Full referrer URLs and campaign query strings are not saved; no IP address is saved in these application records. Session cookies expire after seven days; sign-in nonce cookies after ten minutes. Hosting and Google may process request metadata under their own policies.

Private account and completion records remain until removed by the site owner. Signing out ends your session; clearing browser data does not delete saved account progress. For account removal, contact the project owner through the channel where this playground was shared. Counts begin with this release and do not reconstruct earlier visitors.
